questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Heat or Dolphins?
At which ground did Tamzyn Hartman record their career-best innings (45, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2023/11/19.

questions.question: Bernadine Bezuidenhout set a database record (13/14 season, List A) with a value of 463. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Bernadine Bezuidenhout.

questions.question: Which South African bowler took the first-ever hat-trick in the history of the ICC Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup, in 2023?
questions.explanation: Landsman, then 18, took the first hat-trick in U19 Women's T20 World Cup history against Scotland in 2023.

questions.question: At which ground did Boland record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — highest total of 558, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: At which ground did Kei record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 174, against Heat on 2018/02/10.
